verify.note: Default: original and build fed each recording, every register with R, all eight banks and the fetch count at every frame end, no port FF write; the sites from every A. Enhanced: every recording, at every changed site the hook against the original from the same state, every register with R, all RAM but the changed bytes and the stack below SP, clock, MMU, write map, and every flip's picture against a model; the handler inside each hook kind; 14 broken builds on a2's first 1,500 frames, one that survives over the other recordings' first 3,000 (the cleared-screen case needs fx1). Pace, soak, flicker, beam and the real loader are in games/mad_mix_2.md "Evidence".
